name: inventory-management-system
description: Inventory Management System backed by Lark/Feishu Bitable

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w backend && npm run clean -w frontend
